title: Penthouse May 1988 Spring Special Kelley Wild Oscar Arias Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers bright; light corner wear and small chips at the corners of the back cover. Spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, May 1988 - Spring Special, original $4.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet of the Month: Kelley Wild.

Cover features: Exclusive Oscar Arias - how to end the war in Nicaragua; Q&A: what makes the political pampering of Pat Robertson & Jesse Jackson so necessary?

Back cover: Carlton cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
